FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
[NAAC Accredited Grade “A++”]
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006
BRIEF ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE No. 17 OF 2026
Dated : 06-08-2026
Online Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for teaching positions of Assistant
Professor available in various Departments/ Institutes/ Centres of the University as indicated
below:-
1. Main Campus:
Arabic, Bio-Chemistry, Bio-Informatics, Bio-Technology, Centre of Central Asian Studies, Distance &
Online Education, Economics, Education, Food Science & Technology, Foreign Languages, Geo-
informatics, History, Home Science, Iqbal Institute of Culture & Philosophy, Law, Lifelong Learning
Persian, Political Science, Urdu & Zoology.
Note:- These posts are distinct and independent from the posts which are presently sub-judice and
subject to the outcome of the relevant Court Cases.
IMPORTANT DATES:
I. Submission of Online Forms/Hard Copy from: 10-08-2026
II. Last date for Submission of Online Forms 09-09-2026 (upto 4.00 p.m.)
III. Last date for Submission of Hard copy 14-09-2026*
*- Candidature of candidates who fail to submit the Hard Copy of the Application Form
within the stipulated time shall be rejected without any notice.
The detailed Advertisement Notice/s containing essential qualifications, reservation of posts
and other terms & conditions will be available on the University website
www.kashmiruniversity.net under Jobs/Recruitment link from 07-08-2026 (A.N).
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
(Recruitment)
No: F/Advt.AP/KU/REC/26
Dated: 06-08-2026
